_source: adammoore/llm-pa-ver services/gemini_service.py (adhd_context, analyze_task_for_adhd, generate_daily_schedule, provide_adhd_coaching) + app/api/gemini/{analyze,coaching,schedule}/route.ts; framings cross-checked against adammoore/llm-pa backend/modules/prompt_system.py
_note: Short reflection/coaching PROMPTS salvaged from Adam's two prior PA repos and reworded as invitations (PDA-aware: no guilt, no demands, always skippable). These COMPLEMENT the two existing banks: prompt_bank.json holds cadence-keyed initiation prompts, action_learning_questions.json holds the 19-item 'Twenty Questions' deep-reflection set. This file adds ADHD-coaching framings the others lack: getting started, splitting work down, self-compassion, and reframing. Usage: offer ONE prompt per check-in, never a batch. Daily → activation; weekly → reflection/reframe; monthly → self_care/breakdown. Nothing here is a diagnostic label; these are gentle openers only.

activation: What's the smallest first move here — the one that takes under two minutes?
If you started for just five minutes and could stop after, what would you touch first?
What would make starting feel ten percent easier right now?
Is there a low-energy version of this you could do instead?
What could you set up now so future-you finds it easier to begin?
Would a short timed burst help — focus for a bit, then free to stop?
What's pulling your attention away, and can any of it wait?
What's one part of this you could start without deciding the whole thing?
breakdown: If this were three smaller steps, what would the first one be?
What's the part you already know how to do?
Which piece feels heaviest — could it be split again?
What could you hand off, delay, or drop entirely?
What does 'done enough' look like for today?
Which step unlocks the others if you do it first?
What's the one thing that, if handled, would make the rest lighter?
self_care: Where's your energy right now — and what would actually match it?
What have you managed to eat or drink today?
When did you last take a real break?
What would rest genuinely look like tonight?
What's one kind thing you could do for yourself today?
Are you running low on anything — sleep, food, quiet, company?
What would you say to a friend who'd had the day you've had?
reflection: What went a little better than you expected?
What's one thing, however small, you're glad you did?
What drained you today, and what filled you back up?
What did you notice about how you work best?
What's worth carrying into tomorrow — and what can you set down?
Where did you show up, even when it was hard?
What's one loose thread you'd like to pick back up — no pressure if not?
reframe: Is this a 'won't' or a 'can't right now'? Both are okay.
What changes if progress, not perfection, is the goal?
Your brain works its own way — what does it actually need here?
What's the story you're telling about this, and is it the only one?
What's genuinely in your control right now?
If this feels hard because it matters, which part matters most?
What would 'good enough' free you up to do next?
